senses.definition: Food from the sea, including that derived from fish, shellfish, crustaceans, cephalopods, seaweed, algae, marine mammals, and other marine organisms.
senses.example: But most of all, they were jealous because these strangers feasted daily on great turtle, albacore and sail-fish, the sweetest of all seafoods.

senses.definition: Food from any aquatic source, including not only salt water but also fresh water.
senses.example: For quotations using this term, see Citations:seafood.
